verdict.rationale: GST runs a developer API portal and an offline upload tool, so an official CLI is a plausible capability for this kind of product. However, no evidence shows one exists. The developer API portal [gst-india-docs-1] is a developer building block, and the GST Offline Tool [gst-india-docs-12] is an adjacent invoice-upload utility, not a command-line interface, so neither earns credit.
